strengths: The pressure register changes in every chapter: technical self-proof, ordinary social diffusion, institutional fit, then research evidence conflict.
No chapter completes a full hero arc; each plants or advances a different long-term contradiction.
Chapter2 remains useful as decompression between three denser chapters.
Chapter4 reuses Tang Yu and Xu Hang, both already introduced in chapter2, so name load does not expand sharply.
The first four chapters establish that the ensemble lives in overlapping but separate worlds rather than one permanent group.
risks: Three of four chapters still involve documents, code, files or explicit work artifacts; chapter5 should shift toward a decision embodied in money, city, time or family geography rather than another desk-bound evidence scene.
Xu Hang appears in chapters1,2 and4; avoid letting him become accidental connective protagonist or universal verifier.
Tang Yu's research line should now recede for a while so the long arc has temporal spacing.
The first four chapters are intellectually legible; upcoming chapters need more bodily, spatial and material stakes.
recommended_chapter5_function: threshold/refusal through concrete life bundle rather than another technical discussion
preferred_structure: braided_two-offer_chapter only if each scene remains incomplete and neither is used to summarize a universal life lesson
